picks.excerpt: Chinese robotics company Agibot brought its full-size A3 and half-size X2 humanoid robots to a London launch event on June 30, showing off backflipping, football-playing 'humanoids' up close and pitching robots that 'understand you, talk to you, and work for you.'
picks.rationale: Hands-on with production-bound humanoids that talk, understand and act — the strongest embodied-AI/robots anchor in the pool and a fresh carryover, credible TechRadar reporting.

picks.excerpt: Apple seeded the third developer beta of visionOS 27, the Vision Pro update that brings eye-tracked Siri AI activation, an anywhere-placeable Siri orb with visual awareness of what you're looking at, curved windows and panorama-to-spatial environments.
picks.rationale: Concrete new spatial-AI interaction patterns (gaze-triggered Siri, gaze-aware orb, curved windows) that change how XR/spatial designers prototype; distinct from yesterday's iOS 27 public-beta card.

picks.excerpt: XDA reviews AMD's tiny Ryzen AI Halo box and finds it does what Nvidia's DGX Spark does at a fraction of the power — a compact local-AI machine for running LLMs at home without the cloud.
picks.rationale: Highly actionable on-device-AI beat — a small, low-power box that runs local LLMs, directly relevant to designers wanting private local models; chosen over the GMKtec NucBox to avoid a second Notebookcheck card.

picks.excerpt: Hands-on with the Nothing Phone (4b), the first of Nothing's new (b) series: a budget phone with a dedicated Essential Key that triggers Essential Voice, Essential Search and the company's AI-powered apps at an 'impossible' price.
picks.rationale: Fresh hands-on of a new phone line with a hardware AI key (Essential Voice/Search) — a real on-device AI-UX design signal; kept over the GSMArena announcement of the same launch. Scores high enough to justify a second-day Nothing card (distinct device from the Ear 3a).

picks.excerpt: Apple's new AI security-camera features in the Home app — Apple Intelligence video descriptions and searchable 4K HomeKit Secure Video clips — will require a 2TB iCloud+ subscription, and 9to5Mac argues gating camera AI behind a storage tier is the wrong call.
picks.rationale: Fresh angle on how consumer AI features get monetized — Apple gating camera AI (natural-language video descriptions, searchable clips) behind a storage tier; the smart-home sub-topic and a distinct outlet, chosen over the Google Home update and SwitchBot cam.
